messages:
Marco (Sales): Quick pass to CS — Solace Health signed pilot (3mo) today. Contract includes SSO + private subnet requirement.
Aisha (CS): Thanks — looping in eng/support for provisioning and any blockers. What are their success criteria?
Marco (Sales): Pilot goals: 1) ingest PHI via secure connector, 2) <500ms tail latency for inference, 3) SSO + SCIM for 20 testers. They asked about on-prem later but starting hosted with VPC peering. Budget note: strong renewal pressure at 90 days if perf or data controls lag.
Aisha (CS): Noted. Ownership: I'll own onboarding cadence and enablement. Need eng for KV store access and support for SSO mapping.
Devon (Eng): Got it. What infra flavor — Dedicated or Hosted w/ VPC?
Marco (Sales): Hosted w/ VPC peering for now. Might request Dedicated if throughput grows.
Rina (Support): I can own runbook and escalation path. Will need contact at Solace for network and IdP config.
Aisha (CS): Contact is Maya Patel (maya@solacehealth.com). They can provide SAML metadata and network CIDR next week.
Devon (Eng): Action: I'll spin up a dedicated VPC peering task. Need CIDR + expected egress. Can someone create an eng ticket with headers below?
Aisha (CS): Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4512 — summary: Solace Health pilot VPC peering + SAML. Assigning to Devon.
Devon (Eng): Assigned; ETA for baseline provisioning: 3 business days after CIDR + metadata. If PHI ingestion requires private connectors we'll need a security review (1 week).
Rina (Support): I'll draft the onboarding checklist and a short SSO test plan. Leaving placeholders for: IdP metadata, test user CSV, firewall rules.
Aisha (CS): Timeline proposal: Week 1 — network + SSO smoke; Week 2 — ingest test data (non-PHI), Week 3 — PHI ingestion dry run under security supervision.
Marco (Sales): Sounds good. I'll ask Maya for CIDR and IdP by EOD Monday.
Devon (Eng): Risk flags: PHI triggers compliance review and possible longer lead time for private connector. Flagging as renewal risk if compliance gating >30d.
Aisha (CS): Action owners: Marco — collect Maya's items (CIDR, SAML metadata) by Mon EOD; Devon — provision VPC peering + security triage ticket CS-4512; Rina — onboarding runbook & test plan by Tue. I'll schedule weekly syncs with Solace and internal owners.
ops-bot: Reminder set — weekly internal sync every Wed 10:00 starting 2026-04-01.
Rina (Support): Can we add an A/B test for latency baseline? I can collect traces during the first ingestion.
Devon (Eng): Yep — will add tracing hooks and a dashboard. Need sample payload shape.
Aisha (CS): Marco — please ask Maya to provide sample payload (anonymized) or schema.
Marco (Sales): Will do. One more ask from legal: they want data residency note in pilot agreement. I'll forward legal's comment.
Aisha (CS): Noted — that goes to Security/Compliance review too. I'll mark CS-4512 as high priority.
Devon (Eng): If compliance requests on-prem, we should start cost estimate early.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team. I'll follow up in CS-4512 and add a short summary to the Solace customer record.
Marco (Sales): Thanks — team aligned.
Aisha (CS): Closing loop: internal owners pinned, next internal sync Wed 10. If anyone needs to reprioritize, ping here. :thumbsup:
